# Vendored third-party code

## p5.js v1.11.2

`p5.min.js` is [p5.js](https://p5js.org) v1.11.2, © the p5.js contributors, released under
the **GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1**. The full licence text is in
`p5-LICENSE.txt` alongside it.

It is vendored rather than installed so the page has no build step and no network
dependency — the whole project runs with `node server.mjs` and nothing else. The file is
unmodified from the official distribution.
